spoken_transcript: Influenza A is typically characterized by high fever. This virus causes high fever and can make your child uncomfortable. Fever may not drop well for the first 24 to 48 hours, even with antipyretics. Antiviral treatment does not guarantee that fever will fall within 24 to 48 hours. After starting treatment, keep watching your child's overall condition and fluid intake. Use one fever reducer first for discomfort. Alternate only with a clinician's plan, recording each drug's dose and timing; ask before ibuprofen under six months. Maintain room temperature at 24 to 26°C and dress your child in light clothing. For dehydration, offer small amounts of oral rehydration solution. Sports drinks are not an equivalent substitute. Breathing trouble, chest pain, poor response, 8-hour anuria, or febrile seizures are emergencies. If symptoms don't improve or your child is lethargic, consult your pediatrician without delay.

review_summary_ko: 비디오는 A형 독감 고열 관리에 대한 정확하고 안전한 정보를 제공합니다. 모든 의학적 조언은 출처에 충실하며, 시청각적 무결성도 우수합니다. 약물 복용 방법, 해열제 교차 복용 시 주의사항, 탈수 예방, 실내 온도 유지, 그리고 응급 상황에 대한 명확한 지침이 잘 전달되었습니다.
